issues.on_page: Capital contributions (27,625) + Proceeds from sale 1,293; total other financing sources (uses) (26,332)
issues.issue: p2 labels the (27,625) 'Contributions - internal activities'. It matches business-type Capital contributions (net) +27,625 on p6, so it is an internal transfer between governmental and business-type activities and arguably belongs in transfers_out and business_type.transfers_net, not other_financing. The arithmetic and the computed marking are correct.

The amount matches the page. It is the business-type side of the internal contribution from governmental funds (p2 'Contributions - internal activities'), so it is arguably transfers_net rather than other_financing.
